info.name: Product Payment API — local checkout contract
info.description: Requests for the implemented buyer-facing backend API. Start the backend locally and set the collection variables before sending requests. Prices and stock are server-owned; 201 on checkout creation does not mean payment approval. The signed POST /payment/events endpoint is provider-to-server only and intentionally has no runnable example here: never fabricate a checksum or submit a synthetic event as an authority signal. Local Swagger UI is available at /api and OpenAPI JSON at /api-json while the backend is running. No public deployment URL is claimed.

request.description: 200 returns id, name, description, currency, priceCents and current stock. The product ID must be UUID v4; malformed IDs return 400, missing products 404. This route does not create a checkout or change stock.

200 returns productId, quantity, currency, unitPriceCents, productAmountCents, baseFeeCents, deliveryFeeCents and totalCents. Amounts are integer COP cents calculated by the server. Invalid input returns 400; missing product 404; insufficient stock 409; unsupported currency 422. A quote does not reserve stock.

200 returns a browser-safe publicKey and current endUserPolicy and personalDataAuthorization documents, each with token and permalink. Review both current documents and obtain their tokens for a checkout. Provider unavailability returns 503. Never commit, export, or sync captured tokens.

header.description: Buyer-generated UUID v4. Reuse only for the exact same checkout intent.

request.description: Requires a transient browser-generated card token, both current consent tokens, explicit consent, and delivery details. Never send raw card number, expiry or security code to this API. Do not persist payment/consent tokens in a shared Postman environment or export. 201 returns a local reference, current status and server-calculated quote, NOT approval or delivery. Same key and same canonical checkout data replay the original checkout without another payment submission. A different checkout with the same key returns 409. Validation or missing consent returns 400; missing product 404; insufficient stock 409; unsupported currency 422. PENDING and SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN need later status verification; do not blindly retry a charge after timeout.

header.description: The original checkout UUID v4; this is not general user authentication.

request.description: 200 returns only reference, paymentStatus and fulfillmentStatus from local persistence; no provider call or state change. Reference has the form txn_<uuid-v4>. An invalid reference or key returns 400; an unknown or mismatched reference/key returns 404. APPROVED with STOCK_UNAVAILABLE means charged but no delivery; operator attention is required. DECLINED, VOIDED and ERROR do not decrement stock or create delivery.
